description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF and MAG +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Water], [Awoken Salvager], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Spirited Guardian Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Salvager
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Water abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Hydro Grenade after using a Water ability

description.name: Spirited Guardian Mode
description.text: Casts Al Bhed Aid after using Water abilities, removed after triggering three times
